components.name: Top bar
components.html: 学生の家計管理デモユーザー
components.css: .ds-topbar { display:flex; justify-content:space-between; background:#fff; border-radius:6px; padding:.7rem 1.5rem; color:var(--muted,#6b6477); font: .875rem sans-serif; } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-topbar { padding:.65rem 1rem; } }

components.name: Income summary
components.description: Income gradient card and selected month.
components.css: .ds-card { position:relative; overflow:hidden; box-sizing:border-box; min-height:156px; border-radius:9px; padding:1.3rem 1.4rem 1rem; background:linear-gradient(115deg,#fe9496,#f77bb0); color:#43364e; font-family:sans-serif; } .ds-card::after { content:""; position:absolute; width:180px; height:180px; border-radius:50%; right:-65px; top:-80px; background:#ffffff26; pointer-events:none; } .ds-card strong { display:block; color:#2f253a; font-size:clamp(1.7rem,2.5vw,2.25rem); font-weight:650; font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums; } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-card { padding:1rem 1.2rem; min-height:132px; } }

components.name: Welcome panel
components.description: White welcome panel beside the native login and registration forms.
components.html:
学生の家計管理

毎月のお金を、見える形に。

このパソコンだけで使う、発表・学習向けのアプリです。
components.css: .ds-welcome { background:#fff; border-radius:10px; padding:2rem; color:var(--ink,#342e42); font-family:"Source Sans Pro","Yu Gothic","Hiragino Kaku Gothic ProN",sans-serif; } .ds-welcome h1 { color:var(--purple-ink,#7430b8); font-size:2rem; font-weight:650; letter-spacing:-.02em; } .ds-welcome small { color:var(--muted,#6b6477); } @media (max-width:700px) { .ds-welcome { padding:1rem; } .ds-welcome p,.ds-welcome hr { display:none; } }

narrative.overview: The user-selected Purple reference informs the light lilac canvas, white navigation and content panels, and three bright financial summary cards.
keyCharacteristics: Pink, blue and teal summary gradients
Compact sans type and tabular yen values

rules.name: Chart and card colors
rules.body: Trend charts use purple income and pink expenses. Summary cards use pink income, blue expenses and teal balance.

dos: Do preserve native controls and focus.
Do label chart and progress values.
donts: Don't substitute chart series colors for card gradients.
